text: XXXIII. 1. Aṭṭh'; imāni bhikkhave dānavatthūni. Katamāni aṭṭha? 2. Chandā dānaṃ deti, dosā dānaṃ deti, mohā dānaṃ deti, bhayā dānaṃ deti, ‘dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi, na arahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetun'; ti dānaṃ deti, ‘imāhaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmī'; ti dānaṃ deti, ‘imaṃ me dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdati, attamanatā somanassaṃ upajāyatī'; ti dānaṃ deti, [page 237] XXXIV. 1-5 Dāna-Vagga. 237 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] cittālaṅkāracittaparikkhāratthaṃ dānaṃ deti. Imāni kho bhikkhave aṭṭha dānavatthūnī ti.
